text:
alex: Heads-up — after the FP8 activation-quant change landed on main, I'm seeing token-level divergence and occasional NaNs in mixed-precision matmul on A100-L4. Repro with KV cache ON.
jing: can repro. divergence starts around token 3 in our tiny repro. saving traces now.
sam: quick question — is the runtime picking a different kernel based on sequence/batch? try forcing the fp16 path to check if it's quant-specific.
alex: forced fp16 path -> no NaNs, outputs match baseline. so this narrows it to fp8 activation path.
maria: sharing a minimal repro command I used:
```
python tools/repro.py --model=redwood-mini --quant=fp8 --kv-cache=1 --seed=42 --prompt="The quick brown"
```
maria: repro logs (snip):
```
[2026-02-14 10:12:01] matmul select: kernel=matmul_fp8_tile_v2 seq_len=64 scale=0.00341 finite=1
[2026-02-14 10:12:01] matmul exec: kernel=matmul_mix_fp8_fp16 seq_len=128 scale=nan sum_nan=1
```
perf-bot: perf-regression alert on main @abc123: matmul p50 +12%, p99 +30% (A100-L4, batch=1).
cheng: looking at batching heuristics — when batch>1 the kernel chooser flips tiling and the scale computation path changes; that could expose a calibration edge-case.
jing: also suspicious: KV cache reuse path triggers a short-sequence matmul (cached kv + new query) which hits a different quant normalization branch.
sam: hypothesis: calibration stats (min/max or running moments) aren't reset or are mixed between fresh and cached sequences, producing non-finite scale.
alex: why didn't CI catch this? our unit tests don't exercise short-seq cached matmuls with fp8 activation.
maria: mitigation idea: gate fp8 activation behind feature flag and pause canary rollout until we fix.
perf-bot: canary traffic reduced to 0% after rollback.
jing: next dev steps I suggest:
- add a deterministic unit repro that reproduces the NaN in CI (short seq + KV enabled)
- add kernel-level assert to check scale is finite before using it
- extend quant calibration tests to exercise tiling permutations and batch>1 cases
sam: also audit the quant table generation path for 4-bit fallback and INT8 compatibility — mismatched quant params could be a cousin bug.
cheng: I'll instrument the kernel chooser to dump chosen tiling + scale calc inputs (scale, zero_point, max_abs) for the failing trace.
alex: I'll open an issue and assign to eng-ml + eng-runtime with logs/traces attached. temporary rollback + flag sounds good.
alex: https://redwood/issue/4201 opened — includes repro, logs, and profiling snapshots.
jing: one more note: profiling shows matmul time spike coincident with NaN detection; may be fast-fail in kernel path causing weird state.
maria: thanks — we'll coordinate on the PR. :thumbsup:
